reason: My child already goes to a tutor for school preparation, so letters and numbers are covered. I would download the free version and maybe start the 14-day trial, but I don't see why I should pay 24,990 every month on top of the tutor.
objection: It repeats what the tutor already does, and I can't tell if ten minutes on a phone teaches anything or is just a cartoon the child taps through.
would_change_my_mind: If other parents in our kindergarten Telegram group or the tutor showed that the weekly report really tracks progress and saves tutor hours, I would pay the yearly price.
